verdict.rationale: Viam documents an official CLI with a full reference page, confirmed by the probe. It covers data export and SQL/MQL queries, and can call any API method a machine serves with JSON in and JSON out and no code to write. A dedicated doc page explains that an AI agent with a shell can operate a Viam machine the same way a person can. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use of the CLI, and evidence on CLI install/auth flow for non-interactive agents.
